summary: This code sets up an event listener mapping that tells the application which listeners should respond when certain events are triggered. In this case, whenever a SampleEvent occurs, the SampleListener class will be notified and run its handler code.

explanations.1: The $listen property is a protected variable that will be used by the framework's event system to know which listeners to call for which events.
explanations.2: SampleEvent::class gets the full class name as a string (like 'App\Events\SampleEvent'), which serves as the key that identifies what event we're listening for.
explanations.3: SampleListener::class is stored in an array because one event can have multiple listeners — if several listeners needed to respond to SampleEvent, they'd all be listed here.
